pieces.text: I moved to the coast in March. The house is small and the sea is loud at night, and I sleep better than I have in years. Nobody warned me about the gulls.

pieces.name: piece-2
pieces.text: There is a kind of software bug that only appears on the second Tuesday of a month, and I have met it twice. The first time it cost a weekend. The second time I knew where to look, and that is the whole value of experience.

pieces.name: piece-3
pieces.text: A recipe is a promise about the future. You read it on Saturday and it tells you what Sunday will taste like. Most promises are not that honest.
